sources.fact: LBBD74/CF Castle Green is 67ha, mixed ownership, minimum 0 and maximum 7,000 net dwellings, planning-permission-status not-permissioned, with blank geometry and a point only.

LBBD's growth-hub page describes a Castle Green concept involving a 1.3km A13 tunnel, a new neighbourhood and land released for 5,000 homes plus parks, industrial/commercial uses and a new Overground station.
The 5,000-home growth-hub concept is explicitly linked to tunnelling the A13 and related transport/infrastructure change; it is not a planning permission.
A 2023 Cabinet report described Castle Green as a transformation area with potential for up to 12,000 homes subject to a decision on A13 tunnelling and construction of a new rail station.
The 12,000 figure is conditional strategic potential and was discussed in the context of future Gypsy and Traveller provision; it is not a consented-unit count.
Earlier HIF-era material referenced up to 15,000 homes in a broader Castle Green regeneration concept; this demonstrates scenario evolution rather than an additive capacity series.

LBBD describes the A13 tunnel as infrastructure intended to reconnect communities and unlock new neighbourhoods and jobs; the infrastructure concept does not prove delivery or funding of the full Castle Green housing scenario.
The adopted Local Plan 2037 is the starting point for decision-making; allocation/transformation status is policy evidence rather than a planning consent.
The development plan guides application decisions but does not turn strategic capacity scenarios into approved dwelling totals.
Castle Green Park remains an active public park/community/sports space; current-use evidence is kept separate from the wider transformation-area concept.
Site-specific planning status requires exact application/decision evidence; this wave did not verify a current application covering the full CF transformation area.
A Brownfield point or policy area is not an exact application red-line or HMLR title polygon and is not buffered into one.

examples.result: 0–7,000 Brownfield range remains the current register range and is not consented units.
5,000 growth-hub homes is an infrastructure-led concept, not a planning permission.
Up to 12,000 homes is a conditional transformation scenario, not added to 7,000 or 5,000.
Historic up-to-15,000 HIF-era material is retained as an older scenario, not a current capacity total.
A13 tunnel and station dependencies are not assumed delivered.
Current park/community use is not treated as proof the wider transformation cannot occur, nor as proof it has begun.
Mixed ownership is not collapsed to a single title or owner.
Promotion remains zero until exact CF applications, site/title polygons, infrastructure status and statutory overlays are verified.
